note: Forbidden behaviour (a): a grace-LSA whose LS age has the DoNotAge bit set. (b) TestGraceLSANeverSetsDoNotAge drives OriginateOpaque with the restarter's body and asserts grace.Header.Age.DoNotAge() is false and RawBytes[0]&0x80 == 0, so an origination that set the bit goes red. The demand-circuit clause has no path in ze: no production code sets DoNotAgeBit (only types/lsage.go declares and reads it) and flooding copies the installed RawBytes, so the asserted bytes are the flooded bytes. Single-polarity marker holds.
